argument: The twelve shutters must read as one suspended exposure instrument before they read as twelve plates: the off-axis scale, overlapping apertures, color temperature, and asymmetrical silence must compose one room rather than a panel grid.

With labels, readout, controls, caption, and furniture hidden, the first view must read as an authored room of shutters and apertures, not a dashboard, tile array, cavity object, braid, or generic WebGPU demo. After one departure, the closure and remote opening must be findable in the silhouettes.

Pointer movement must remain geometry-neutral. Only leaving after three distinct witnesses, Enter, Space, or the departure control may commit; Delete must restore the exact preceding room and R must release bounded memory.

The place looked at cannot simply answer itself. The most-watched shutter closes while a least-loaded remote shutter opens, so attention becomes a material reversal rather than a cursor-following effect.
The work must visibly leave the recent braid, monolith, and basin grammars. The new unit is an aperture inside a laminated shutter, and departure—not touch, drag, or focus—is the causal event.

Exposure must live in actual aperture size and plate tilt. Four departures remain bounded and liftable; later departures must reconstruct from the altered room rather than resetting to the quiet plates.

Delete v030 if the room is only a decorative panel array, if pointer movement deforms the image, if a two-witness or still departure commits, if remote apertures are cosmetic, if later departures forget, if lifting is inexact, or if the blind field needs its caption to become an archive.
